163:2. Range inclusion `hrange : Set.range w.base ⊆ (W : Set X)`: for `s : S`, apply `(mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi v.2.1).mp v.2.2` at `A := Over.testPointField s`, `t := Over.testPoint s` (instances `Pic0ChartTestPoint.lean:90,96`) to get a `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` of the fibre; D1 gives `IsSplitWitness` of its class, i.e. `s ∈ picRankOneSplitLocus C (picEtMap C w' lamX.1)` (collapse the two functor maps with `picEtMap_comp`/`Subtype.ext` as in `Pic0RankOneLocus.lean:51-57`); then `picRankOneSplitLocus_comp_eq_preimage pi w' lamX.1` (the direction powered by D2) gives `w.base s ∈ W`.

121	`Spec.preimage` of `Spec κ(t) ⟶ Spec A`.  (Over an affine test the carrier of the test object
122	*is* `Spec A`, so the composite is `fromSpecResidueField` alone.) -/
123	instance instAlgebraTestPointFieldAffine (t : (overSpec k A).left) :
124	    Algebra A (testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) :=
125	  (Spec.preimage ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t)).hom.toAlgebra
126	
127	lemma algebraMap_testPointFieldAffine (t : (overSpec k A).left) :
128	    algebraMap A (testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
129	      = (Spec.preimage ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t)).hom :=
130	  rfl
131	
132	/-- **The tower `k → A → κ(t)`** on an affine test.  `Spec` of the tower identity is the
133	factorisation of `Spec κ(t) ⟶ Spec k` through `Spec A`, which is the `Over` triangle of the
134	affine test object — the same identity `isScalarTower_fieldPointAlgebra`
135	(`Picard/Pic0Theta.lean:358`) proves for an abstract field point, here at the canonical
136	residue-field point. -/
137	instance instIsScalarTowerTestPointFieldAffine (t : (overSpec k A).left) :
138	    IsScalarTower k A (testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) := by
139	  refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' ?_
140	  -- Both algebra maps are `Spec.preimage` of a morphism out of `Spec κ(t)`; `Spec.preimage`
141	  -- is a bijection on homs, so it suffices to compare the two morphisms, and there the
142	  -- identity is the `Over` triangle of the affine test object: `(overSpec k A).hom` is by
143	  -- definition `Spec.map (algebraMap k A)`.
144	  have hcomp : ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t ≫ (overSpec k A).hom)
145	      = (overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t
146	          ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) := rfl
147	  -- `Spec.preimage` is injective on the composite, and the composite identity is `hcomp`.
148	  have hw := congrArg (fun f => (Spec.preimage f).hom) hcomp
149	  have hsplit : (Spec.preimage ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t
150	        ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).hom
151	      = (algebraMap A (testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)).comp
152	          (algebraMap k A) := by
153	    have : ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t
154	          ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))
155	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)
156	            ≫ Spec.preimage ((overSpec k A).left.fromSpecResidueField t)) := by
157	      rw [Spec.map_comp, Spec.map_preimage]
158	      rfl
159	    rw [this, Spec.preimage_map]
160	    rfl
161	  exact hw.trans hsplit
162	
163	end Affine
164	
165	/-! ## The field point -/
166	
167	/-- **The bridge: a point of `T.left` as a field point of `T`.**
168	
169	`t : T.left` names the test object morphism `overSpec k κ(t) ⟶ T` whose carrier is
170	mathlib's canonical `Scheme.fromSpecResidueField` and whose triangle over `Spec k` holds
171	by the very definition of the `k`-algebra structure on `κ(t)`.
172	
173	This is the missing input 0 of CHART-U(a): with it, `{t : T.left | P (fibre of λ at
174	κ(t))}` is a legal `Set T.left` for any predicate `P` on classes over a field, and that
175	is what `chartLocus` is. -/
176	def testPoint {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (t : T.left) :
177	    overSpec k (testPointField t) ⟶ T :=
178	  Over.homMk (T.left.fromSpecResidueField t)
179	    (Spec.map_preimage (T.left.fromSpecResidueField t ≫ T.hom)).symm
180	
181	@[simp]
182	lemma testPoint_left {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (t : T.left) :
183	    (testPoint t).left = T.left.fromSpecResidueField t :=
184	  rfl
185	
186	/-- **The field point is supported at the point it came from**: the unique point of
187	`Spec κ(t)` maps to `t`.  (`Spec` of a field has a unique point, so this pins the support
188	completely.) -/
189	@[simp]
190	lemma testPoint_base {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (t : T.left)
191	    (s : (overSpec k (testPointField t)).left) :
192	    (testPoint t).left.base s = t :=
193	  Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply t s
194	
195	/-! ## Naturality along a morphism of tests
196	
197	The law every downstream well-definedness argument runs on.  A morphism `f : T' ⟶ T`
198	does not send the field point of `t` to the field point of `f t` on the nose — the two
199	have *different sources*, `Spec κ(t)` and `Spec κ(f t)`.  What is true, and what the
200	transports of `w4-datb` §1.6 use, is that the square through the induced residue-field
201	extension `κ(f t) → κ(t)` commutes. -/
202	
203	/-- **The residue-field extension a morphism of tests induces at a point**, as a
204	`k`-algebra map `κ(f t) → κ(t)`.  This is `Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap` with its
205	`k`-algebra structure read off; it is the extension along which every fibre-field
206	predicate has to be invariant for a locus over `T` to pull back to one over `T'`. -/
207	def testPointFieldMap {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'.left) :
208	    CommRingCat.of (testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t))
209	      ⟶ CommRingCat.of (testPointField (T := T') t) :=
210	  f.left.residueFieldMap t
211	
212	/-- The residue-field extension of `testPointFieldMap`, as an algebra structure: `κ(t)` is
213	a `κ(f t)`-algebra.  This is the shape the fibre-field invariance lemmas of
214	`Pic0ChartLocusFibreField.lean` consume (`hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_of_fieldExtension`
215	takes `[Algebra L L']`). -/
216	@[reducible]
217	def testPointFieldAlgebra {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'.left) :
218	    Algebra (testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t)) (testPointField (T := T') t) :=
219	  (testPointFieldMap f t).hom.toAlgebra
220	
221	/-- **The naturality square of the bridge**: the field point of `t : T'.left` composed
222	with `f` is the field point of `f t` precomposed with `Spec` of the residue-field
223	extension.  Both sides are morphisms `overSpec k κ(t) ⟶ T` in the slice.
224	
225	This is `Scheme.Hom.SpecMap_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField` in the over category,
226	and it is the only law CHART-U(b)'s transports (i)/(ii) need from this file. -/
227	lemma testPoint_comp_left {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'.left) :
228	    (testPoint t).left ≫ f.left
229	      = Spec.map (testPointFieldMap f t) ≫ (testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t)).left :=
230	  (f.left.SpecMap_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField t).symm
231	
232	end
233	
234	end Over

12	/-!
13	# Native presentations for split field classes
14	
15	A residue-field H¹ witness for the lambda-tied cocycle datum supplies its arbitrary-ring
16	cohomology and rank certificates.  The native all-cartesian base-change theorem then completes
17	the corresponding `PicRankOneNativePresentation` without a separate pushforward hypothesis.
18	
19	A split genus-degree class over a field stays split after every affine coefficient extension,
20	so it supplies those witnesses for each pullback datum.
21	
22	The final theorem is the direct public consumer: a split field class belongs to
23	`PicRankOneOpen`, because every affine pullback receives the presentation constructed here.
24	-/
25	
26	set_option autoImplicit false
27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

30	
31	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
32	  CartesianMonoidalCategory

36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

39	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
40	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
41	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

43	noncomputable section
44	
45	/-- Every morphism between affine tests over `Spec k` is induced by a `k`-algebra map.
46	
47	Unlike `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom`, neither coefficient ring is required to be a
48	field.  This is the form needed when the target of a field-valued Picard point is tested by an
49	arbitrary affine scheme. -/
50	theorem exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing
51	    (R S : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra k R] [Algebra k S]
52	    (t : overSpec k S ⟶ overSpec k R) :
53	    ∃ e : R →ₐ[k] S, t = Over.overSpecMap e := by
54	  have hw : t.left ≫ (overSpec k R).hom = (overSpec k S).hom := Over.w t
55	  let psi : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ CommRingCat.of S := Spec.preimage t.left
56	  have hmap : Spec.map psi = t.left := Spec.map_preimage t.left
57	  have htower : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R) ≫ psi =
58	      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S) := by
59	    apply Spec.map_injective
60	    rw [Spec.map_comp, hmap]
61	    exact hw
62	  let e : R →ₐ[k] S :=
63	    { __ := psi.hom
64	      commutes' := fun r ↦
65	        congrArg (fun f => f r) (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom htower) }
66	  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
67	  ext : 1
68	  exact hmap.symm
69	
70	/-- Complete the native presentation attached to an actual lambda-tied datum.
71	
72	The input is exactly the remaining family-level H¹ obligation.  The degree law follows from the
73	two class equalities stored in `P`; finiteness, projectivity, and rank one follow from the
74	arbitrary-ring certificate theorem; and native pushforward base change is the canonical
75	all-cartesian theorem.  Thus every field concerns the same cocycle datum. -/
76	noncomputable def PicRankOneNativeDatum.toNativePresentation_of_residueH1Witness
77	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
78	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
79	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
80	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
81	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
82	    (hres : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier,
83	      P.datum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
84	    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
85	  PicRankOneNativePresentation.ofCertificatesWithNativeBaseChange
86	    P.cover P.representative P.represents P.datum P.datum_class
87	      (RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum P.datum hpi hres
88	        (fun L ↦ P.classDeg_baseChange L))
89	
90	/-- The arbitrary-affine pullback of a split field class has a complete native presentation.
91	
92	The datum is the representative extracted from the displayed pullback `lam`.  Its residue-field
93	H¹ witnesses come from `hsplit`, while its degree law comes from the equality with `lam`.
94	Consequently all four cohomology/rank fields and the native base-change field concern the same
95	cocycle datum. -/
96	theorem PicRankOneNativePresentation.nonempty_of_fieldPullback
97	    {K A : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
98	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
99	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
100	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
101	    (e : K →ₐ[k] A) (nu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
102	    (hlam : lam.1 = picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e) nu)
103	    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C nu) :
104	    Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) := by
105	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := PicRankOneNativeDatum.nonempty (C := C) pi lam
106	  exact ⟨P.toNativePresentation_of_residueH1Witness hpi
107	    (P.residueH1Witness_of_fieldPullback e nu hlam hsplit)⟩
108	
109	/-- A split genus-degree class over a field belongs to the public rank-one Picard locus.
110	
111	Every affine test morphism into `Spec K` is induced by a `k`-algebra map `K → A`; the
112	preceding producer therefore supplies the exact native presentation required on that pullback.
113	-/
114	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness
115	    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
116	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
117	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
118	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K))
119	    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C lam.1) :
120	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k K)) := by
121	  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
122	  intro A _ _ t
123	  obtain ⟨e, ht⟩ := exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing (k := k) K A t
124	  rw [ht]
125	  exact PicRankOneNativePresentation.nonempty_of_fieldPullback
126	    (C := C) hpi e lam.1 rfl hsplit
127	
128	end

9	/-!
10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
11	
12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
16	
17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
21	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
22	-/
23	
24	set_option autoImplicit false
25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
26	
27	universe u
28	
29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
30	
31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
32	
33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
37	
38	noncomputable section
39	
40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
41	
42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
45	def PicRankOneOpen :
46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
54	      apply Subtype.ext
55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
56	    rw [e]
57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
58	
59	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
60	
61	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
62	
63	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
64	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
65	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
66	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
67	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
68	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
69	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
70	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
71	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
72	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
73	
74	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
75	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
76	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
77	contract. -/
78	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
79	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
80	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
81	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
82	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
83	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
84	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
85	  rfl
86	
87	/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
88	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
89	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
90	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
91	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
92	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
93	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
94	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
95	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
96	  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h
97	
98	/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
99	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
100	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
101	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
102	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
103	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
104	  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h
105	
106	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
107	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
108	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
109	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
110	
111	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
112	
113	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
114	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
115	relative-open gate below. -/
116	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
117	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
118	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
119	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
120	
121	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
122	
123	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
124	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
125	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
126	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
127	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)
128	
129	/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/
130	
131	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
132	
133	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
134	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
135	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
136	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
137	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
138	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
139	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
140	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
141	  W : X.Opens
142	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
143	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
144	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
145	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
146	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
147	    (w : S ⟶ X),
148	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
149	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
150	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
151	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
152	
153	namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
154	
155	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
156	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
157	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}
158	
159	/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
160	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
161	    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
162	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
163	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
164	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
165	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
166	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
167	      φ.app S) D.sq
168	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
169	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
170	  · intro v w hvw
171	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
172	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
173	
174	end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
175	
176	/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
177	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
178	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
179	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
180	        Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))),
181	      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
182	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
183	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
184	  intro X g
185	  let d := D X g
186	  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩
187	
188	/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
189	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
190	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
191	  h

16	/-!
17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
18	
19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
23	
24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
29	
30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
36	-/

291	  obtain ⟨I, hI, Ai, hfield, halg, e, h⟩ :=
292	    (Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod K E.Carrier).mp inferInstance
293	  haveI : Nonempty I := by

295	    haveI : IsEmpty I := not_nonempty_iff.mp hempty
296	    haveI : Subsingleton E.Carrier := e.toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mpr inferInstance

298	  obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty I›
299	  exact ⟨Ai i, hfield i, halg i, (h i).1, (h i).2,

10	# The shared plus-class field collapse (DAT-B B-5 fibre collapse / B-4 gap-1 collapse)
11	
12	This is the **shared plus-class collapse lemma** flagged by `w4-datb-worksheet.md` §5
13	risk 6 and by the B-4 landing note I-0252 ("state it once as a named lemma with a
14	characterizing property … both consume it"): a plus class of the one-step étale-plus
15	Picard group over a *field* becomes an honest relative-Picard class after base change to a
16	suitable finite separable field extension.

18	Over a field `K`, a plus class `p : PicEtAff C K` is `PicEtAff.mk E x` for a presented
19	étale cover `E` of `Spec K` and a descent class `x` (`Picard/PicEtAff.lean`).  Field
20	cofinality (`Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`,
21	`Algebra/EtaleCover.lean` — étale covers of a field are refined by finite separable field
22	extensions) supplies a finite separable `L/K` together with a `K`-algebra map
23	`ℓ : E.Carrier →ₐ[K] L`.  Base-changing `E` to `L` yields a cover with an `L`-point, so the
24	base-changed descent class is, by the descent/cocycle condition (`relPicAlgMap_congr`), the
25	tautological datum of an honest class: `PicEtAff.map C L p` is the plus-unit of the
26	relative-Picard class `relPicAlgMap ℓ x` on `C_L` (`PicEtAff.unit C L …`).

34	  class presented as `relPicMk` of a Čech Picard class `M` on `C_L`, the form the degree
35	  seam (`degAt_of_affineEquiv_eq_unit_relPicMk`) and the shifted-datum extraction
36	  (`exists_cechPicClass_eq`) consume.

12	CHART-U(b)'s transport (ii) (the "one `IsOpenMap` application", `Pic0ChartLocusOpen`
13	keystones 2/3) pushes the engine's open witness locus from the étale carrier `Spec B`
14	down to the test base `Spec A`.  Its remaining mathematical content (I-0252 gap 2) is
15	the *fibre-field invariance* that identifies the preimage of the base locus with the
16	carrier locus: for a prime `q` of the carrier over `p`, the residue-field extension
17	`κ(q)/κ(p)` is separable (étale/étale-plus carrier) and must **preserve** the witness
18	h¹-vanishing of the fibre class.
19	
20	That content is `chartLocus`-free (I-0252's phrasing through the still-undefined
21	`chartLocus`, DAT-C C9, is pure plumbing on top) and is landed here in the **witness
22	form** `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing`
23	(`Pic0ChartLocusOpen`) uses.  The heart is a single module fact:
24	
25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.subsingleton_tensorProduct_field_ext_iff` — for an `S`-module `H`
26	  and a field extension `L → L'` in the `S`-tower, `H ⊗[S] L` is subsingleton iff
27	  `H ⊗[S] L'` is.  Going up is `0 ⊗ = 0`; coming down is the faithful flatness of the
28	  (nonzero) field extension.  **Separability is not needed** — every field extension is
29	  faithfully flat; it is the geometric packaging (étale carrier) that makes the residue
30	  extensions separable, not the transfer.
31	
32	Read through the two-way datum dictionary
33	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness` (C1, GAP-6) — under
34	which the witness predicate at a field `L` is exactly the engine's complex-form fibre
35	condition `Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] L)` — this gives:

37	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing` — the field-parametrised witness

11	/-!
12	# Presented étale covers of an affine base
13	
14	A (singleton, affine) *étale cover* of `Spec A` is a faithfully flat étale `A`-algebra `B`.
15	For the étale-sheafification (plus) construction of the relative Picard functor, the covers
16	of a fixed base must form a *small* directed index: this file realizes them as **presented**
17	covers — a number of variables `n` together with an ideal of `MvPolynomial (Fin n) A` whose
18	quotient is étale over `A` with `Spec` mapping onto `Spec A`.  The type of presented covers
19	of `A` lives in the same universe as `A`, while still capturing every étale cover up to
20	isomorphism of the carrier (`Algebra.EtaleCover.of` and its accessor `ofEquiv`).
21	
22	Surjectivity of the spectrum map is recorded instead of faithful flatness because it is
23	statable without flatness hypotheses; combined with flatness of étale algebras it *is*
24	faithful flatness (`Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_comap_surjective`), and that instance is
25	provided on the carrier.
26	
27	## Main declarations
28	
29	* `Algebra.EtaleCover A`: presented étale covers of `Spec A`, a `Type u` for `A : Type u`;
30	  `E.Carrier` is the covering algebra, with `Algebra.Etale A E.Carrier` and
31	  `Module.FaithfullyFlat A E.Carrier` instances.
32	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.of B hB`: any étale `A`-algebra `B` (with surjective spectrum map)
33	  underlies a presented cover, with carrier identification `Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv`.
34	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.Refines`: `E'` refines `E` when the covering spectrum of `E'` maps
35	  to that of `E` over the base — a mere existence (`Prop`); the plus construction proves
36	  independence of the chosen refinement map, so no choice of map is carried here.
37	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.prod`: the common refinement `Spec (B ⊗[A] B')` of two covers, with
38	  refinement witnesses `prodInl`/`prodInr` — directedness of the index
39	  (`exists_refines_prod`).
40	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.self`: the trivial cover `Spec A` itself, refined by every cover
41	  (`refines_self`) — the base point of the index.
42	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.baseChange`: the pulled-back cover along `A → A'`, with carrier
43	  `A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier` (`baseChangeEquiv`) and the canonical `A`-algebra map
44	  `baseChangeInclude` into it.
45	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`: over a field `K`, every cover
46	  is refined by a finite separable field extension of `K` (single-factor refinement) —
47	  field-extension covers are cofinal, the form the degree theory and Galois descent
48	  consume; `Algebra.EtaleCover.ofField` packages such an extension as a cover.
49	-/

/-- **The degree-`d` layer `pic^d` (worksheet §5 risk 6)**: the classes of `picEt C T` of
degree `d` at *every* field point.  A **subtype**, not a subgroup — for `d ≠ 0` it is a

abbrev picDegLayer (d : ℤ) (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Type u :=

`Type`-valued subfunctor of `picEtFunctor C` cut out by the degree-`d` condition.
Contravariant, no group structure. -/
def picDegLayerFunctor (d : ℤ) : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u where
  obj T := picDegLayer C d T.unop
  map {T T'} g := ↾fun (lam : picDegLayer C d T.unop) =>

      rw [degAt_picEtMap]; exact lam.2 K (t ≫ g.unop)⟩ : picDegLayer C d T'.unop)

  map_comp {T T' T''} g h := by
    ext lam U
    exact congrArg (fun z : picEt C T''.unop => z.1 U) (picEtMap_comp C g.unop h.unop lam.1)

/-!
# Split witnesses from rank-one presentations at a field (Task-C steps D0 + D1)

Two converse-direction bricks for the rank-one openness lane.

* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.exists_overSpecMap_testPoint_comp` (D0) — **testPoint naturality
  in the slice**: for `f : T' ⟶ T` over `Spec k` and a point `t` of `T'.left`, the
  naturality square of the residue-field bridge (`Over.testPoint_comp_left`) is promoted
  to an equation of slice morphisms through a `k`-algebra map of the two residue fields.
  The algebra-map upgrade of `testPointFieldMap` is not done by hand: it is delegated to
  `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing`, whose `Spec.preimage` performs it once.

* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicRankOneLocalPresentation.isSplitWitness` (D1) — **the field
  converse of the presentation contract**: a `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` of a
  genus-degree class over a field `K` yields `IsSplitWitness` for that class.  The
  splitting field is a finite separable single-factor refinement of the presentation's
  étale cover (`Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`); the presenting
  equation is the plus-class field collapse (`PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_of_algHom`) read
  through `P.datum_class`; the witness divisor comes from the presentation's own
  `H¹`-vanishing through the datum dictionary
  (`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton`).

* `AlgebraicGeometry.isSplitWitness_of_mem_picRankOneOpen_field` — membership of a field
  class in `PicRankOneOpen` implies `IsSplitWitness`, by testing with the identity.
  Together with the landed `mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness` this is the fibrewise
  characterization of the rank-one locus at fields.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
open TopologicalSpace Opposite

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open AlgebraicJacobian

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

/-! ## D0: testPoint naturality in the slice -/

/-- **testPoint naturality as an equation of slice morphisms** (Task-C D0).  For a
morphism of tests `f : T' ⟶ T` over `Spec k` and a point `t : T'.left`, there is a
`k`-algebra map `φ : κ(f t) →ₐ[k] κ(t)` through which the field point of `t` composed
with `f` is the field point of `f t`.

This is `Over.testPoint_comp_left` upgraded from the underlying schemes to the slice: the
underlying map of the connecting morphism is `Spec` of `Over.testPointFieldMap f t`, and
its `k`-algebra structure is recovered by `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing`
rather than assembled by hand. -/
theorem Over.exists_overSpecMap_testPoint_comp
    {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'.left) :
    ∃ φ : Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t) →ₐ[k]
        Over.testPointField (T := T') t,
      Over.testPoint t ≫ f
        = Over.overSpecMap φ ≫ Over.testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t) := by
  have hw : Spec.map (Over.testPointFieldMap f t)
        ≫ (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t))).hom
      = (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := T') t)).hom := by
    calc Spec.map (Over.testPointFieldMap f t)
          ≫ (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t))).hom
        = Spec.map (Over.testPointFieldMap f t)
            ≫ ((Over.testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t)).left ≫ T.hom) := by
          rw [Over.w (Over.testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t))]
      _ = ((Over.testPoint t).left ≫ f.left) ≫ T.hom := by
          rw [← Category.assoc, ← Over.testPoint_comp_left f t]
      _ = (Over.testPoint t).left ≫ T'.hom := by
          rw [Category.assoc, Over.w f]
      _ = (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := T') t)).hom :=
          Over.w (Over.testPoint t)
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing (k := k)
    (Over.testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t))
    (Over.testPointField (T := T') t)
    (Over.homMk (Spec.map (Over.testPointFieldMap f t)) hw)
  refine ⟨φ, ?_⟩
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  rw [Over.comp_left, Over.comp_left, ← hφ, Over.homMk_left]
  exact Over.testPoint_comp_left f t

/-! ## D1: presentation at a field ⇒ split witness -/

/-- Triviality of a module is preserved by any coefficient extension: a tensor product
with a subsingleton factor is a subsingleton. -/
private theorem subsingleton_tensorProduct_of_subsingleton_left
    {R X Y : Type u} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X]
    [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y] (h : Subsingleton X) :
    Subsingleton (X ⊗[R] Y) := by
  refine subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun z => ?_
  induction z with
  | zero => rfl
  | tmul x y => rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
  | add u v hu hv => rw [hu, hv, add_zero]

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
-- The plus-class field collapse through the base-changed étale carrier needs the larger
-- budget (same as `isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap_of_algHom`).
/-- **The field converse of the rank-one presentation contract** (Task-C D1): a
`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` of a genus-degree class over a field `K` makes that class a
split witness.

The splitting field `L` is a finite separable single-factor refinement of the
presentation's étale cover.  The presenting Čech class is the image of the presentation's
own `P.datum.cechPicClass` under the carrier-to-`L` refinement, by the plus-class field
collapse; its witness divisor with vanishing `H¹` exists because the presentation's
`h1_vanishing` field survives the coefficient extension to `L` (`0 ⊗ = 0`), which is
exactly the datum dictionary's condition at `L`. -/
theorem PicRankOneLocalPresentation.isSplitWitness
    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K)}
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
    IsSplitWitness C lam.1 := by
  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hKL, hLfin, hLsep, ⟨ψ⟩⟩ :=
    P.cover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom
  letI := hLf
  letI := hKL
  letI := hLfin
  letI := hLsep
  letI hkL : Algebra k L := ((algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap k K)).toAlgebra
  haveI htowkKL : IsScalarTower k K L := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
  letI hBL : Algebra P.cover.Carrier L := ψ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI htowKBL : IsScalarTower K P.cover.Carrier L :=
    .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (ψ.commutes x).symm
  haveI htowkBL : IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
    change algebraMap k L x = ψ (algebraMap k P.cover.Carrier x)
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K P.cover.Carrier, ψ.commutes,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K L]
  have hM : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K lam.1)
      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
            P.datum.cechPicClass)) := by
    rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_of_algHom C P.representative ψ,
      P.datum_class, relPicAlgMap_mk]
  have hsub : Subsingleton ((datumPair P.datum).H1 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] L) :=
    subsingleton_tensorProduct_of_subsingleton_left
      ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hW1⟩ :=
    (P.datum.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton L).mpr hsub
  exact isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness C lam.1
    (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L) P.datum.cechPicClass)
    hM W hW hW1

/-- **Membership of a field class in the public rank-one locus implies the split-witness
condition** — the converse of `mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness`, obtained by testing
the membership contract with the identity of `overSpec k K`.  Together the two theorems
characterize the rank-one locus fibrewise at fields. -/
theorem isSplitWitness_of_mem_picRankOneOpen_field
    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K)}
    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k K))) :
    IsSplitWitness C lam.1 := by
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mp h K (𝟙 (overSpec k K))
  have e : ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map
        (𝟙 (overSpec k K)).op lam).1 = lam.1 :=
    picEtMap_id C lam.1
  have hsplit := P.isSplitWitness
  rwa [e] at hsplit

end
